# Product UX Research

1. Read the PRD and current discovery evidence. Distinguish observed facts, user-stated needs, assumptions and hypotheses.
2. Identify the primary user, context, trigger, desired outcome, constraints and failure costs.
3. Define personas only as hypotheses unless backed by interviews or product evidence.
4. Map the end-to-end workflow from source import to analytics feedback.
5. Identify user pain points and moments of uncertainty (rights, processing, AI selection, editing, publishing).
6. Define jobs-to-be-done and measurable success signals.
7. Create research questions, representative tasks and test scenarios.
8. Do not invent research quotes, user counts or validated statistics.
9. Recommend the smallest useful research activity and record open questions.
10. Deliver a research summary with findings, assumptions, confidence and next decision.

For ClipYantra include podcasters/interview creators, educators/technical creators, gamers/streamers, entertainment creators and content operators.
